note: Raw answers of v3's /account page, its POST and POST /account/signout, captured over HTTP from a migrated and seeded SQLite install, with two sessions of one viewer. Pinned: status, content-type, cache-control, location, retry-after, set-cookie (normalised) and the body bytes. Normalised, and only these: every CSRF token -> <csrf>, the session cookie's value -> <id>, expires -> <date>. `/account?done=pw|out` is the same page with a toast; `setup` is what the capture changed first.
